i_backbone_quadratic.fit: least squares of log median (B1) on log rel_norm, per text

predictions.ii_backbone_holds_through: rel_norm 1e-2: median (B1) <= 1e-3 on both texts at noise-0.01

iii_olmo_directions_above_backbone.statement: at the nearest backbone rung on whole-vector distance, each reads median (B1) >= 10x the backbone's, both texts

iv_qwen_instruct_near_backbone.statement: median (B1) within 3x (either side) of the Qwen isotropic rung qwen-noise-0.01 (R-B8), both texts

predictions.v_on_path_at_or_below_corpus: on every rung whose corpus median (B1) is above 2x the float16 floor, on-path median (B1) <= corpus median (B1)

prediction.statistic: per rung and text, median over held-out sequences [40, 50) of the mean per-token KL(pi_fresh || pi_stale) over the 256-token continuation after a 768-token prefix (B1), nats/token; x = relative L2 weight distance over the whole parameter vector, as 0008 recomputed it
